import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def analyze(df, index):
    import matplotlib.dates as mdates
    d = df.copy()
    d['accept_time'] = pd.to_datetime(d.accept_time)
    b = d.groupby('acceptance_burst_id').agg(
        tasks=('delivery_task_id', 'size'), groups=('spatial_group', 'nunique'),
        start=('accept_time', 'min'), end=('accept_time', 'max'))
    b['size'] = np.where(b.tasks <= 4, 'small', 'large')
    within = d.sort_values('accept_time').groupby('acceptance_burst_id').accept_time.diff().dt.total_seconds().dropna()/60
    between = (b.start-b.end.shift()).dt.total_seconds().dropna()/60
    rates = []
    for column in ['acceptance_order_in_burst', 'completion_order_in_burst']:
        pairs = []
        for _, q in d.groupby('acceptance_burst_id'):
            if q.spatial_group.nunique() > 1:
                values = q.sort_values(column).spatial_group.to_numpy()
                pairs.extend(values[1:] == values[:-1])
        rates.append(float(np.mean(pairs)))
    split = b.groupby('size')['groups'].apply(lambda v: float((v > 1).mean()))
    if index == 0:
        evidence = dict(acceptance_bursts=len(b), accepted_tasks=len(d),
            maximum_within_burst_gap_min=round(float(within.max()), 2),
            minimum_between_burst_gap_min=round(float(between.min()), 2))
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(11, 6.5), constrained_layout=True)
        axes[0].scatter(d.accept_time, np.zeros(len(d)), marker='|', s=200, color='#c77c3d')
        for name, row in b.iterrows():
            axes[0].text(row.start+(row.end-row.start)/2, .12, f'{name}\n{row.tasks} tasks', ha='center', fontsize=9)
        axes[0].set(yticks=[], ylim=(-.15, .35), title=f'{len(d)} acceptances in {len(b)} distinct bursts')
        axes[0].xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%H:%M'))
        axes[1].hist([within, between], bins=np.linspace(0, max(between)+5, 30), label=['Within burst', 'Between bursts'])
        axes[1].set(xlabel='Acceptance gap (minutes)', ylabel='Number of gaps')
        axes[1].legend(frameon=False)
    elif index == 1:
        evidence = dict(same_group_adjacency_in_acceptance_sequence=round(rates[0], 3),
            same_group_adjacency_in_completion_sequence=round(rates[1], 3))
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5), constrained_layout=True)
        q = d[d.acceptance_burst_id == 'B04']
        palette = dict(zip(sorted(q.spatial_group.unique()), ['#3976a8', '#c77c3d', '#4f846c']))
        for y, column in enumerate(['acceptance_order_in_burst', 'completion_order_in_burst']):
            for group, rows in q.groupby('spatial_group'):
                axes[0].scatter(rows[column], np.full(len(rows), y), color=palette[group], s=75,
                    label=group.split('_')[-1] if y == 0 else None)
        axes[0].set(yticks=[0, 1], yticklabels=['Acceptance', 'Completion'], ylim=(-.5, 1.5),
            xlabel='Task position in sequence', title='B04: destination groups in each sequence')
        axes[0].legend(title='Spatial group', frameon=False)
        axes[1].bar(['Acceptance', 'Completion'], rates, color=['#71808d', '#4f846c'])
        for i, rate in enumerate(rates): axes[1].text(i, rate+.025, f'{rate:.1%}', ha='center')
        axes[1].set(ylim=(0, 1.08), ylabel='Same-group share of adjacent task pairs', title='All multi-group bursts')
    else:
        evidence = dict(small_burst_split_rate=round(split['small'], 3), large_burst_split_rate=round(split['large'], 3))
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.5), constrained_layout=True)
        for name, row in b.iterrows():
            ax.scatter(row.tasks, row['groups'], s=90, color='#3976a8' if row['size']=='small' else '#c77c3d')
            ax.annotate(name, (row.tasks, row['groups']), xytext=(5, 7), textcoords='offset points')
        ax.set(xlabel='Tasks accepted in burst (small: ≤4)', ylabel='Distinct destination groups',
            yticks=[1, 2, 3], ylim=(.7, 3.4), title='Burst size and spatial splitting')
    print(evidence)
    return evidence

evidence = analyze(df, 0)
plt.show()
